The chore plan has been created.

**Plan file created:** `specs/chore-d76a7c72-fix-enum-value-mismatches.md`

The plan addresses fixing 7 TypeScript enum value mismatches across all 14 products in `mock-data04.ts`:

| Enum Type | Replacements Needed |
|-----------|---------------------|
| SongkranSuitability | 'no' → 'neither' (11 occurrences) |
| CoverageType | 'not-applicable'/'not-covered' → 'exposed' (15 occurrences) |
| TextureType | 'smooth' → 'matte', 'structured' → 'textured' (8 occurrences) |
| WeddingAppropriateType | 'not-appropriate' → 'none', 'conservative' → 'morning' (4 occurrences) |
| LayerCompatibility | 'relaxed' → 'loose' (11 occurrences in arrays only) |
| OutfitCompleteness | 'complete' → 'standalone', 'needs-bottom-and-top' → 'needs-both', 'accessory'/'footwear' → 'needs-accessories' (8 occurrences) |
| OutfitRoleType | 'neutral' → 'supporting' (1 occurrence) |

The plan includes detailed notes to avoid changing similar values in unrelated contexts (e.g., `colorTone: 'neutral'`, `layeringStyle: 'relaxed'`, `outfitRole: 'footwear'`).
